query: select m.name as "Membership:Link/Membership:140", m.member as "Member:Link/Member:160", m.membership_plan as "Plan:Link/Membership Plan:140", m.start_date as "Start:Date:100", m.end_date as "End:Date:100", m.status as "Status:Data:100", case when m.status = 'Active' and datediff(m.end_date, curdate()) between 0 and 30 then 'Yes' else '' end as "Expiring Soon:Data:100" from `tabMembership` m order by m.end_date asc
